name: Aura of Experience needs a level 60 character on the realm
contract: Item 818059 Aura of Experience is refused, and kept, while no character on the account has reached level 60, as its CoA tooltip states (This item requires you to have a level 60 on this realm to be able to consume), unless the character is below the level of another character on the account (the account catch-up planned in PR #10113, covered by aetherial-reliquary-account-catch-up). Another character at the alt's own level is not enough. Once that character is saved at level 60, the same alt consumes one item and receives aura 818059.

steps.label: Another character at the alt's own level does not unlock the aura
The refused use answers SPELL_FAILED_DONT_REPORT beside the tooltip text
A saved level 60 character on the account unlocks the aura
